question_text: KEYBOARD is to TYPIST as STEERING WHEEL is to ___?

hint_ladder.title: Relasyon ng keyboard at typist
hint_ladder.text: Keyboard ay tool, gamit ng typist. Ang relasyon ay 'tool-user'. Hanapin ang user ng steering wheel.

hint_ladder.title: Eliminahin ang maling sagot
hint_ladder.text: Ang car, road, at mechanic ay may kinalaman sa steering wheel, pero hindi sila user. Ang user ay direktang gumagamit.

hint_ladder.title: Tutukan ang tao
hint_ladder.text: Tulad ng typist na gumagamit ng keyboard, ang driver naman ang direktang gumagamit ng steering wheel. Ito ang tamang tool-user pair.

hint_ladder.title: Siguradong sagot
hint_ladder.text: Ang tamang sagot ay 'Driver' dahil siya ang operator ng steering wheel, kumpletong tool-user analogy.

A.text: You might have chosen A because a steering wheel is part of a car, but the analogy asks who uses it, not what part it is.

B.text: Correct! A driver uses a steering wheel just as a typist uses a keyboard.

C.text: You might have chosen C because a car drives on the road, but the road is not the user of the steering wheel.

D.text: You might have chosen D because a mechanic repairs steering wheels, but they are not the primary operator of the tool.

next_time_rule: Sa tool-user analogies, alamin kung sino ang direktang gumagamit, hindi ang bagay na kinalalagyan o nag-aayos.
deconstruct_text:
Imagine nasa barangay hall ka, may typist na mabilis mag-type ng dokumento gamit ang keyboard. Ang keyboard ay tool, ang typist ang user.

Ngayon, isipin mo ang steering wheel. Sa jeep, ang driver ang humahawak nito para mani-obra sa daan. Steering wheel = tool, driver = user.

Choices: A) Car – parte yun, hindi user. C) Road – daanan, hindi user. D) Mechanic – nag-aayos, hindi gumagamit araw-araw. So B) Driver ang kaparehong relationship: tool-user.
